entries.brief: Original SKAZ D&D2014 fantasy reference-book spell illustration. Mature painterly realism, restrained natural colors, strong compact silhouette readable at32px on both dark navy and cream backgrounds, generous transparent margins. Single centered motif, no text, no UI, no border, no cartoon, no noisy scene. A translucent silver-blue robed traveler passing halfway through a solid weathered stone arch fragment, overlapping ghost contours, visible strong silhouette. No skull, no teleport ring.
